cards.title: Production VM · admin locked out of RDP
cards.symptom: Client could not connect over RDP for a day. 18,353 failed logons in 24 hours from dozens of IPs; the local admin account locked every 10 minutes.
cards.cause: Port 3389 open to the internet times a 10-attempt lockout policy. Not an Azure block: VM healthy, no control-plane changes.
cards.fix: Read-only diagnosis from the guest event log, then an NSG allowlist the same day. Zero-trust tunnel access later.
cards.takeaway: Brute force does not need to win to lock you out. Close the port first; hardening the password comes second.

cards.title: Nim #26785 · seq growth under refc
cards.symptom: A repro that appended 1,005 elements ended with one.
cards.cause: Growing a seq can run a GC cycle; its finalizers mutated the object while growth kept the payload pointer taken before the allocation.
cards.fix: Payload-replacement allocations now run with the GC disabled. Merged 24 Nov 2026.
cards.takeaway: If a growth path can trigger finalizers, the old payload pointer is stale the moment you allocate.
